properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs test_read; detect.rs criteria_gap_id). A test whose locked criteria moved after its data reads unknown, naming them, until its criteria_changed_after_data gap is acknowledged with a reason; then it reads as before. Every write lands; nothing is refused; a change before the data changes nothing. Builds on the criteria lock that reports the change (cap:a-tests-criteria-are-locked-when-its-data-arrive-and-a-later-change-is-reported), which still reports it.
properties.name: A hypothesis test whose criteria moved after its data supports nothing until the owner acknowledges the change
